entities.summary: Roland Schmaltz is a German chess grandmaster. His peak Elo rating was 2559. He has the nickname "Hawkeye" and is a champion in bullet chess. Roland Schmaltz was a journalists & chroniclers from Mannheim (b. 1974-11-15, Mannheim). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
